text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...It's over.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(A once-in-a-lifetime Classic race. Its fever
has truly been engraved into my body—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (...I'll walk forward together with this passion.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Toward races in a future yet unseen—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...!
Ikuno Dictus put on a strong run once again!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She's been consistently steady in both the Oka Sho and the Yushun Himba. Watching her just puts me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I have returned, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we finally pulled it off...!
Yeah, we finally pulled it off...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Ikuno Dictus was fatigued from the race upon returning,
her stride was steady and powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She returned in far better shape compared to the Oka Sho and the Yushun Himba; I can truly feel how much she's grown...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Once again...
thank you for letting me challenge every single Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Without Trainer, I never would have felt
this burning passion—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running through the Triple Tiara with Ikuno Dictus.
That will undeniably become invaluable experience for us—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That conviction feels so warm right now... and makes me genuinely happy."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Ikuno Dictus-san!
Excuse me, could we have a quick word with you!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"If you could give us a comment
on today's race and your future outlook...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In today's condition, it shouldn't be a problem.
I shall answer the call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, while dealing with reporters' interviews in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—Having run the entirety of the Triple Tiara,
please tell us how you feel right now!”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
There's definitely a great sense of accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe that the small things I strive for each day
have accumulated to make me who I am today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The feeling that every single day's effort has paid off...
Right now, it just feels so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"—You mentioned 'things you keep in mind daily'—
could you tell us more about that?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: They are 'Maintenance' and 'Management.'

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Whether in races or during daily training,
I discipline myself and prepare for unforeseen circumstances
to always deliver the best possible performance—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see Ikuno Dictus's interview?
She's, like, super disciplined about self-care...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: —To be honest, you do hear a lot about racing Umamusume getting injured. Ikuno Dictus's mindset might be really important.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Following the Shuka Sho, it felt as though Ikuno Dictus was drawing even more attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most of it was praise for her self-management abilities,
having performed in every leg of the Triple Tiara
and remaining in peak condition nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path Ikuno Dictus has carved with her hoofprints
is beginning to earn recognition for her technical prowess
in "maintenance" and "management."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now...
it felt as joyous as if it were happening to myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And today, I was having a meeting with Ikuno Dictus
to decide on our future goals, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Regarding our future goals,
may I make a proposal first?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
......In my Senior year, I—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai, the Tenno Sho (Spring), the Yasuda Kinen, and the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I would like to make running in all four of these races my ultimate goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I caught my breath in utter astonishment.
All because the proposal was so extraordinarily staggering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She understood all too well what kind of proposal it was.
Her eyes spoke far more eloquently than words――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Spring Senior Triple Crown. A collective name
for three GⅠ races: the "Osaka Hai,"
"Tenno Sho (Spring)," and "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Osaka Hai" to decide the strongest at medium distance, the "Tenno Sho (Spring)" contested at the longest distance of 3,200m, and the Grand Prix "Takarazuka Kinen"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vying for the crown across these three races... this is the true royal road of the Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just running all three races of the Spring Senior Triple Crown puts an immense toll on an Umamusume.
The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There's the distance gap between the 2000m of the Osaka Hai and the 3200m of the Tenno Sho (Spring). On top of that, all three races take place within a tight window of just three months.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to this sheer brutality, no Umamusume
has ever achieved the Spring Senior Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Furthermore, it is exceedingly rare for an Umamusume
like Ikuno Dictus, who ran the Tiara route,
to advance to the Spring Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, merely challenging the Spring Senior Triple Crown
is already an astonishing enough proposal, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of challenging the grueling Spring Senior Triple Crown,
Ikuno Dictus also expressed her desire to enter
the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Held in June, the Yasuda Kinen is a 1600m turf GⅠ race that decides the strongest spring miler."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if we assume we're running the Spring Senior Triple Crown,
the story changes completely.
That is to say—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen, which concludes the Spring Senior Triple Crown, is held close to the Yasuda Kinen, making it a grueling consecutive campaign with almost no rest in between.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A choice that would turn the already grueling Spring Senior Spring Triple Crown into something even more merciless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running a wide range of races from the mile to long distance...
This has got to be the most grueling GⅠ race rotation conceivable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However, precisely because of that.
choice_data_list: —It's worth running all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Something was proven during that interview
at the 'Shuka Sho' the other day."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It means proving the value of our 'management'
far and wide through our track record—carved by our own hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And that's when it hit me.
If I can safely run through an unprecedentedly
brutal rotation, that would be—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this will further elevate the value of “management” and help many people recognize its importance once again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"And I believe this will give courage
to the Umamusume who are about to take on
such grueling races."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Those who already understand the value of “management” can use my hoofprints as a reference to enhance the precision of their own “management” later on—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
People who kept their distance from 'management'
for various reasons might recognize its value
and be more willing to meet us halfway...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And... it might just become emotional support
for someone when they step onto the turf—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...If everyone could utilize "management" more effectively than they do now as an aid to fulfill their goals—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I believe this will lead to the future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Where no Umamusume...
loses anything beyond victory—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A future where everyone can unleash all of their racing abilities
and keep running for as long as they desire.
...To such a future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As my heart raced at the future she spoke of,
I was reminded once again.
choice_data_list: (That's right, Ikuno is... such a kind girl.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus possesses a kind heart—she can't turn
a blind eye to anyone in trouble and will lend a hand
even if it means sacrificing her own time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Known even by her friends as someone who 'looks after others,'
there is no way her heart wasn't aching
over the injuries of the girls from her generation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had surely been thinking about it all along.
About what she could do for those
who were forced to leave the turf—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now, Ikuno Dictus has shown me the answer.
If so, what I must do as her Trainer is—
choice_data_list: Let's carry it forward to the future, together.
Let's carry it forward to the future, together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So that, even just a little, there is less sorrow for the Umamusume, for everyone involved in racing, and for the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To turn these prayers, wishes, and feelings into our future. To pave the way for that—
choice_data_list: Let's take on this grueling rotation...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I had faith you would say that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The goal is set, and my resolve is firm.
All that remains is to give shape to guidance and etch it into reality.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
“—Target races set: Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring),
Yasuda Kinen, and Takarazuka Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My eyes met Ikuno Dictus's unexpectedly.
There was no doubt about it. "IRON WILL" had just set a goal on her own before I could even give the order...!

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"—A rotation combining the Senior Spring Triple Crown with the Yasuda Kinen
is undeniably an unprecedentedly grueling
racing schedule."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"‘However, based on the feedback from the data of
Ikuno Dictus and her Trainer in the recent Triple Tiara—’"

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: "I have concluded that this rotation will maximize both of your performance and motivation."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: "I will now present various plans effective for this rotation. Please review them."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It's almost as if they're cheering us on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "IRON WILL has also changed—transformed by the way Ikuno Dictus has run so far."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Thus, Ikuno Dictus's challenge for the Triple Tiara came to an end, and a new goal was set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our first target is the first leg of the Spring Senior Triple Crown—
the Osaka Hai, which decides the strongest at medium distance...!
